messages:
Maria: quick q — for the new embeddings route (search-embeds) who should own the feature flag that toggles the quantized model? org? project? route? model-level?
Jon: good q. my read: precedence is org > project > route > model. route overrides model so route can flip for all models used by that route.
Maria: hmm ok. but we have a use-case where we want to enable new model only for traffic to route A but not B where same model is used. model-level would let us enable per-model across all routes.
Kevin: @Maria +1. If route-level is available prefer route-level for rollout. model-level for model-specific experiments. org-level only for company wide kill-switch.
Sara: can we add an emergency cutoff that always trumps lower scopes? like an explicit emergency flag that sits above org?
Jon: we already have org-level `platform.emergency_disable` — that is highest priority. Agree it's worth spelling out in docs and adding a short flowchart.
Sara: also need guardrail: if p95 latency increases >200ms or error-rate spike >0.5% then auto rollback. who owns configuring that? ops or platform?
Maria: tagging @ops-runbook @SRE — need a quick PR to add latency guardrail to rollout config and link the alert.
deploy-bot: deploy started: canary rollout to 5% traffic for search-embeds with model=quantized-v2
Kevin: will review the PR today, pinging @SRE for monitor alert config and thresholds.
Sara: FYI for canary audience, plan is 5% first, then 25% after 1h if no regression. also add audience split by device (mobile vs web) to catch platform-specific regressions.
Maria: thanks all. I'll update the flag doc to show resolution order + emergency kill flow and add an example snippet:
```
# resolution order (applied highest-first)
- platform.emergency_disable  # highest, immediate global kill
- org.featureX_override
- project.search.overrides.featureX
- route.search-embeds.feature_toggle
- model.quantized-v2.feature_toggle  # lowest priority
```
Maria: If no objections I'll move to the canary at 05:00 UTC tomorrow. :thumbsup:
Kevin: :+1:
ops-runbook: noted, will prep alerts and playbook (runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/emb-canary)
SRE: we'll add a p95 latency dashboard and the auto-rollback webhook. ping us once the PR lands for validation.
Maria: awesome — PR link incoming in ~15m, will cc owners.
